profile.description: Almoosa Health Company operates as a private healthcare provider in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It stores medical items and sells medicine, cosmetics, and disposable medical items. The company also operates specialist and rehabilitation hospitals, medical and emergency centers, pharmacies, mental health clinics, and oncology centers, as well as a college of health sciences. Its medical specialties include pain management, lymphatic massage, hyperbaric oxygen therapy, occupational therapy, speech and language disorders, personality and behavioral disorders, supportive devices and prosthetics, urology, ophthalmic surgery, general surgery, otolaryngology (ear, nose, and throat), wound care, emergency medicine, audiology, rheumatology, allergy and immunology, health education, angiography and interventional radiology, infectious diseases, chest diseases, dermatology, internal medicine, pediatrics, dentistry, nephrology, endocrinology, gastroenterology, pediatric neurology, physiotherapy, psychiatry, bone and joint surgery, psychiatric rehabilitation, therapeutic nutrition, and vascular medicine. The company was formerly known as Al Moosa Specialist Hospital and changed its name to Almoosa Health Company in February 2024. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Al Mubarraz, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Almoosa Health Company operates as a subsidiary of Abdulaziz bin Abdullah Almoosa Investment Company.
